metadata.case_name: HO YUN KAN v. SAM SING TRANSPORTATION CO. (A FIRM)

plaintiff.occupation_before: Stevedore (also worked as delivery worker from time to time)

injuries.description: fracturing both the tibia and fibula about mid-way between the knee and the ankle
source: two of these bundles fell and struck the Plaintiff on his left leg fracturing both the tibia and fibula about mid-way between the knee and the ankle.

manifestations.description: Pain in the leg especially when there is a change in weather or after he has walked upstairs or for long periods
Required crutches for about eight months
Unable to return to stevedoring or any other heavy work; restricted to sedentary or lighter jobs

treatments_received: Fractures were reduced and a plaster cast applied
Operation carried out whereby a metal plate was inserted with screws into the bones
Bone taken from the upper tibia to enhance bone healing at the fracture site (bone graft)
Transferred for convalescence to the Kowloon Hospital
Removal of the plate and screws from his leg (admitted 6 August 1987)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities resulting from the fracture and residual discomfort in the left leg
Loss of earning capacity and restriction from heavy manual labour (unable to return to stevedoring)
